description: Add tab/screen fade transitions and enhance modal animations. Configure Expo Router tab transitions and verify/enhance modal slide-up + fade animations.
steps: 1. In app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx, update the Tabs component screenOptions to add animation: 'fade' for smooth transitions between tabs. For the SidebarLayout Tabs (web desktop), add screenOptions={{ headerShown: false, tabBarStyle: { display: 'none' }, animation: 'fade' }}.

2. For the NativeTabLayout Tabs (mobile), add animation: 'fade' to screenOptions. Test if the built-in fade works on iOS, Android, and web. Note: React Navigation/Expo Router tab animation support varies by platform.

3. If built-in tab animation doesn't work consistently, implement a workaround: wrap each tab screen content in FadeInView with direction='none' (opacity only) that triggers on mount. This provides consistent entrance animation.
4. In app/(modals)/_layout.tsx, verify current modal animations. The add-task and settings screens already have animation: 'fade'. Check pomodoro, overdue-rollover, feedback, and profile screens.
5. Update pomodoro screen options to use presentation: 'transparentModal', animation: 'slide_from_bottom' for slide-up effect. Verify on iOS, Android, and web.
6. Update overdue-rollover screen options similarly: presentation: 'transparentModal', animation: 'slide_from_bottom'.
7. For feedback and profile (fullScreenModal), add animation: 'slide_from_right' or 'slide_from_bottom' depending on desired UX.
8. Test modal open/close animations on all three platforms. If native animations don't work on web, consider adding Reanimated-based modal animation wrapper for web platform only.
9. Verify that modal backdrop tap-to-close still works and doesn't interfere with animations.
acceptance_criteria: Switching between tabs shows a subtle fade transition (200-250ms)
Add-task modal slides up from bottom with fade backdrop on all platforms
Pomodoro modal slides up from bottom
Overdue rollover modal slides up from bottom
Feedback/Profile modals have appropriate entrance animation
Modal close animations work smoothly (reverse of entrance)
Animations work on iOS, Android, and web
verification: Manual test: Navigate between all four tabs — verify fade transition or at minimum no jarring instant switch
Manual test: Open Add Task modal — verify slide-up or fade animation
Manual test: Open Pomodoro modal — verify slide-up animation
Manual test: Open Settings — verify animation
Manual test: Close each modal — verify smooth close animation
Test on web browser, iOS simulator, Android emulator
findings: Implemented tab fade transitions and enhanced modal animations: 1) Added animation: 'fade' to both SidebarLayout Tabs (web ≥768px) and NativeTabLayoutInner Tabs (mobile/narrow web) in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx. 2) Enhanced modal animations in app/(modals)/_layout.tsx: pomodoro and overdue-rollover now use presentation: 'transparentModal' with animation: 'slide_from_bottom' for action-sheet feel; feedback and profile use animation: 'slide_from_right' for full-screen navigation feel. 3) Existing add-task and settings fade animations preserved. 4) All modals now have headerShown: false and appropriate contentStyle for transparent backdrop. Note: Expo Router's animation support varies by platform - fade transitions are CSS-based on web, native animations on iOS/Android. Built-in tab animation should work consistently; if issues arise on specific platforms, the FadeInView wrapper approach from step 3 can be added as fallback.
